# 7402 - Quadruple 2-input NOR gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7402.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7402.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 4 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7402 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7402.png) | ![7402 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nor2.png) | ![7402 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nor2.png) |

A rectangle with both diagonals drawn corner to corner (an X filling the box).

How to tell it on a drawing: X across the whole box = NOR.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1Y | output | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1Y = NOT(1A OR 1B) | 1Y is the NOR of 1A, 1B. |
| 4 | 2Y = NOT(2A OR 2B) | 2Y is the NOR of 2A, 2B. |
| 10 | 3Y = NOT(3A OR 3B) | 3Y is the NOR of 3A, 3B. |
| 13 | 4Y = NOT(4A OR 4B) | 4Y is the NOR of 4A, 4B. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 12 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

- [TI SN5402/SN7402/SN74LS02/SN74S02 datasheet SDLS027](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn7402.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7402
